Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation. Per our call I put together a short POC plan and draft success criteria so we can align on scope and timelines. High level next steps below and attached the doc: NewCor_POC_SuccessCriteria_v1.docx

POC goals (3 weeks):
- Validate Redwood API for summarization & structured extraction on a subset of customer support tickets (10k messages).
- Meet latency SLO: p50 < 150ms for 512-token requests on Dedicated/hosted test instance.
- Acceptable quality baseline: F1 >= 0.78 on our labeled set (we can use your dev set).

Evaluation plan / ownership:
- NewCor: Priya (evaluation lead), will provide sample dataset and labeling script.
- Redwood: Marissa (AE) + Lauren (CS) will support onboarding, and Dev (infra) will provision keys and SSO.

Access & security items requested by your InfoSec on call:
- API key for the trial environment (time-limited).
- IP allowlist guidance for your proxy / egress IPs.
- SSO invite (Okta/Google SSO) for Priya and the evaluation team.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Access provisioned + SSO invites.
- Week 1: Baseline ingest + smoke tests.
- Week 2: Run evaluation sets and iterate on prompts.
- Week 3: Review results and decide next steps (Dedicated trial or extended pilot).

Ask: Can you confirm the evaluation lead, expected dataset delivery date, and any internal approvers for security? Once I have that, I’ll loop in Dev to provision access.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
